headline: Key URL Handling Functions in helpers/url.go
why: This file contains critical functions for URL manipulation that are heavily utilized across multiple modules. Changes here could disrupt the URL generation and handling logic, affecting a wide range of functionalities.
checklist: Review changes to URLize, AbsURL, and RelURL functions.
Check for impacts on resources that import this file.
Ensure consistency in handling of base URLs and language prefixes.
Update any related documentation for URL handling.
